hypothesis: The screened parent identity (DeepFM) re-ranks within-user impressions via learned feature crosses. The loss arm should test whether switching from logloss to bpr_global, which uses within-user and global pairwise preferences, further improves the ranking objective on top of DeepFM. Across runs, bpr_global alone was measured at ~0.6028 mean and DeepFM at ~0.6039, so combining them may push the identity above the current 0.60144 screen bar.
